The '''Xandonia system''' lay in the [[Askarian sector/Legends|Askarian sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] known as [[Xandonian night terror]]s.<ref name="Shon-Ju" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Xandonia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square P-11.<ref name="EAOC" />
